tx_not_mined_immediately.meaning: the submitted transaction with insufficient gas is not mined immediately and remains pending
tx_not_mined_immediately.checkpoint: before the pending transaction is executed

executed_after_intended_deadline.meaning: the pending transaction is executed at a later time, after its intended deadline
executed_after_intended_deadline.checkpoint: at execution of the delayed transaction

executed_at_disadvantage.meaning: the delayed transaction is executed by a malicious actor or MEV bot at a disadvantage to the original submitter
executed_at_disadvantage.checkpoint: at execution of the delayed transaction

assumptions: The deadline argument is intended to bound the time within which the transaction may be executed.
The delayed transaction is the same increaseLiquidityCurrentRange transaction submitted by the original submitter.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a concrete intended deadline value or the actual execution time, so the 'after intended deadline' relation is represented only as a grounded Boolean.
Report does not state who submits the delayed transaction or that anyone can call increaseLiquidityCurrentRange.
No concrete amount, value, or specific disadvantage is quantified for the delayed execution.

limitations: The disadvantage to the original submitter is not quantified; only the qualitative Boolean is encoded.
The report describes the delayed execution as possible, not as an established occurrence.
The no-op deadline check is treated as the root cause and is not encoded as a precondition.
